text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff. The race to end the year... I gave it everything I had, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What's with all this energy?! The crowd's
more
excited than I've ever seen it. Is
Oi's Tokyo
Daishoten always like this?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But wait—where's Tarumae?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I wonder... how successful I was.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Was I good enough? Did they see me for
who I
am?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure they all have their own favorite
racers.
But if I can become the dirt race
champion...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can bring all of these cheers to

Tomakomai. I'm sure that'd put a smile
on the
faces of everyone back home.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, Acute!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? Amazing, right? This
is what
it's like to run in the end-of-year
dirt G1!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's incredible. It's almost too
much to take
in.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Each and every racer runs with so much
passion,
but even combined, it pales
against the sheer
energy of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty tough to make yourself the
centerpiece
in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
It didn't feel like any of us
were in
control.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It was like both Tarumae and I were
swept along
for the ride by the energy in
the air. But even
still...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I want it to be bigger! And I
want to
take it on one more time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
According to my palm reading, my fate
will turn in a drastic new direction next
year! Next time, I'm gonna stand at the
center of the storm and blow everyone
away!
